How much does it typically cost to build a website?

A professional landing page generally starts from around IDR 700,000 to IDR 1,000,000, excluding hosting and domain costs if required.
Larger or more complex projects will be quoted based on their scope and requirements.
What payment method do you accept?

I usually require a 40% upfront payment before development begins.
The remaining balance is paid upon project completion.
Payments are made via bank transfer using the account details I provide directly.

The timeline depends on the project's complexity.
As a reference, a professional company profile website generally takes around 18 days to complete.
Do you offer long-term maintenance or hiring?
Yes. I offer ongoing development and maintenance services for projects I've built, as well as long-term collaborations when needed.
